entries.mechanism: TAXSIM runs at its latest 2024 law year. Connecticut indexes the section 12-702 personal exemption and the section 12-703 personal-credit thresholds and applies the section 12-700(b) three-per-cent phase-out recapture; the residual is the 2024-to-2026 vintage of those exemption, credit, and recapture thresholds. The pipeline reports 361.25; TAXSIM 2024 reports 380.38. Vintage, not a pipeline defect; the pipeline matches PolicyEngine ct_income_tax_before_refundable_credits at 2026 to the cent.
